summary: The air over the battlefield lies in layers now: ground mist in the low ground, a sunlit haze above, smoke plumes that drift off downwind, and weather that varies across the map. A net of sunlight plays over shallow beds and flickers on hulls and piers.
stage: Existing gameplay captures: dawn low sun, support barrage and naval shallows; camera settings documented in PR #223.
rationale: Caustic patterns and plume drift need motion. The three existing silent clips show the current result, while the paired stills isolate the appearance changes and enlarge the marked regions. Caustics are the clearest motion example; distant dawn mist is deliberately subtle. These clips are not before/after videos and do not establish GPU cost.

capture.provenance: Existing media committed at the source revision below; capture context is documented in https://github.com/Dynasty9/Frontline/pull/223. This record inventories those artifacts, not a new recording.
capture.renderer: PR documents Forward+ at High, Ultra water for the caustics clip, and a separate Compatibility fallback still.
capture.video_format: 1600x900 VP9, 30 fps, no audio; caustics 7 s, barrage 10 s, dawn 9 s.
capture.limits: The original recording commands and historical before revision are not stored in a capture manifest. Preserve the supplied paired stills without assigning an unverified baseline. Motion, not performance, is evidenced here.
